description.zh: 牧师在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Priest talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【治疗 Beta 开荒】魔杖单刷，双生戒律覆盖护盾与恢复，再经精神强化点到强化真言术：盾。 【暗影 Beta 开荒】同样以魔杖和精神分流为核心，再加上更长的暗言术：痛与抗打断。
body.en: [Healing Beta Start] Wand damage for solo kills, Twin Disciplines on your shields and Renew, then Mental Strength into Improved Power Word: Shield. [Shadow Beta Start] The same wand and Spirit Tap core, with a longer Shadow Word: Pain and pushback protection on top.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.

provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
